newsitem.title: USA: General Motors Corp Q1 oper net rises.
newsitem.headline: General Motors Corp Q1 oper net rises.

text.p: Oper shr $2.30 $0.93
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTES - 1996 net excludes income from discontinued operations of $219 million from Electronic Data Systems Corp, which was spun off in 1996.

1997 results include special items of $55 million or $0.07/shr after tax gain from Volkswagen AG civil lawsuit settlement and $50 million or $0.07/shr after tax charge to close Delphi Interior and Lighting Trenton, N.J. plant in calendar 1998.

1996 results include unfavorable after-tax impact of $900 million or $1.20/shr for work stoppages stemming from Dayton, Ohio, brake plant strike; and $72 million or $0.07/shr gain from sale of 2.5 percent equity stake in Hughes Electronics Corp's DirecTV.
1997 Q1 North American Operations net profit $764 million vs loss $279 million.
1997 Q1 Delphi Automotive Systems net $180 million vs $79 million.
1997 Q1 International Operations net $317 million vs $432 million.
1997 Q1 General Motors Acceptance Corp net $372 million vs $309 million.
1997 Q1 Hughes Electronics Corp net $235 million vs $312 million.
1997 Q1 net profit margin from continuing operations 4.8 percent vs 2.3 percent.
1997 Q1 total cash and marketable securities $14.6 billion vs $7.6 billion.
1997 Q1 worldwide wholesale sales 2,185,000 vs 1,958,000.
1997 Q1 U.S. car and truck market share 30.2 percent vs 31.2 percent.
1997 Q1 worldwide market share 15.1 percent vs 15.8 percent.
1997 Q1 U.S. days supply of inventory for cars 81 vs 84; and 91 vs 81 for trucks.
Per-share data is fully diluted, which is the same as primary earnings per share.
